name: Ballard Food Bank
note: Unopened food. Warehouse door off 14th Ave NW & NW 49th St. Mon 11–3, Tue 11–6, Wed 11–1, Thu 11–6, Fri 10–12.

name: Rainier Valley Food Bank
note: Unopened food. Warehouse via the back gates on 50th Ave S, Tue–Fri 9–2.

name: West Seattle Food Bank
note: Food Mon–Fri 9–3, Wed until 7. Clothing is taken here too, but they prefer the Clothesline on Delridge.

name: North Helpline Lake City Food Bank
note: Unopened food. Tue, Thu, Fri 10–1. Park in the yellow loading zone on 33rd Ave.

name: Northwest Harvest SODO Community Market
note: Food drop-off Mon 2–6:30, Wed and Fri 8:30–1.

name: FamilyWorks Wallingford Food Bank
note: Loading-dock door. Tue–Wed 9–3, Thu 9–6, Fri 9–3. Call (206) 647-1770 to schedule.

name: White Center Food Bank
note: Unopened, unexpired food during open hours or when staff are on site on weekdays.

name: West Seattle Food Bank Clothesline
note: New or like-new clothing, bedding, tents, suitcases. Tue, Thu, Sat 10–1. Items left outside hours are thrown away.

name: FamilyWorks Family Resource Center
note: Kids' clothing and small toys only. Tue 11–1, Wed 2–5, Thu 2–4, Fri 11–2. Ring the doorbell.

name: Northwest Center Donation Bin
note: Unattended outdoor bin at the North Transfer Station.

name: Treehouse Store (foster youth)
note: Clothing and books new or like-new, toys brand-new only. Alley loading dock, Tue–Fri 9–4, Sat 9–2. Book ahead for a carload or more.

name: WestSide Baby
note: Kids' items only, up to size 14/16 and ages 0–12. Mon–Thu 9–4. No cribs, car seats, or furniture.

name: KidVantage Shoreline Hub
note: Kids' items only: clothing, toys, books, bikes, bedding, towels. Tue 10–12, Sat 11–1. Sign up on their site.

name: KidVantage Issaquah Hub
note: Kids' items only. Tue and Fri 9:30–11, some Saturdays. Sign up on their site.

name: Seattle Goodwill
note: For now, only items up to carry-on suitcase size. Take furniture to Ballard or Shoreline. Daily 10–7.

name: Ballard Goodwill
note: Takes larger donations and furniture. Daily 10–7, may pause 1–4pm. No mattresses, pianos, or large fitness equipment.

name: Ballard Goodwill Donation Center
note: Drive-up only. No furniture. TVs and monitors 19 inches or smaller.

name: Capitol Hill Goodwill
note: Daily 10–7. Small site, so call (206) 812-7583 before bringing furniture.

name: Ravenna Goodwill Donation Center
address: 4637 Union Bay Pl NE, Seattle, WA
note: For now, only items up to carry-on suitcase size. No furniture.

name: Shoreline Goodwill
note: Takes larger donations and furniture. Daily 10–7.

name: St. Vincent de Paul Donation Warehouse
note: Drop-off only, no store. Tue–Fri 10–3. No furniture at this site.

name: St. Vincent de Paul Kenmore
note: Mon–Sat 11–4. Call 425-483-9497 before bringing furniture.

name: Value Village Tukwila
note: Small furniture only. Daily 9–8. Donations benefit Northwest Center.

name: Assistance League Thrift Shop
note: Adult clothing, kitchenware, decor, linens, books, DVDs. Thu–Fri 12–4, Sat 10–4. No kids' items or electronics.

name: Habitat for Humanity Store Southcenter
note: Daily 10–6, free pickup available. Furniture must be complete and clean. Appliances 10 years old or newer. Lamps, mirrors, and decor, but not dishes or linens.

name: Habitat for Humanity Store Bellevue
note: Mon–Sat 10–6, free pickup available. Same rules as Southcenter.

name: Seattle Humane
note: Towels, fleece blankets, and washed pet beds only. Bins in the lower lot, open 24/7.

name: PCs for People Seattle
note: Laptops, desktops, phones, tablets, monitors, refurbished for low-income households. Mon–Fri 9–3. Call 206-222-2060.

name: Friends of the Seattle Public Library Bookshop
note: Books only, no DVDs, CDs, or magazines. Thursdays and the 2nd Saturday, 10–3. Up to about 15 boxes.

name: Books to Prisoners (at Left Bank Books)
note: Paperbacks preferred, 1–2 boxes. No textbooks, CDs, or marked books.

name: Scarecrow Video
note: DVDs and other video. Recommended by the library Friends. Call 206-524-8554 first.

name: Bike Works Warehouse
note: Bikes in any condition, parts, accessories. Back of the Hudson Building (#111), daily 11–5. No e-bikes.

name: Bike Works Bike Bin (North)
note: Green bin at the North Transfer Station reuse center. Up to 10 bikes, no e-bikes.

name: Bike Works Bike Bin (South)
note: Bike bin at the South Transfer Station. No e-bikes.

name: The Mountaineers Gear Library
address: 7700 Sand Point Way NE, Seattle, WA
note: Outdoor gear from 2020 or newer: tents, snowshoes, skis, jackets. No climbing gear. Contact them first.

name: Ted Brown Music (TBM Outreach)
note: Playable or repairable band, string, and percussion instruments, guitars, keyboards. During store hours.

name: Music4Life at American Music
note: Print Music4Life's donor form and put it in the instrument case.

name: Seattle JazzED
note: By appointment. Fill in their online form first.
